G3201.root: middle voice of an apparently primary verb
senses: μέμφομαι to blame, find fault: absol., [[r:ROM.9.19|Rom 9:19]]; with accusative, αὐτούς (WH, txt.; αὐτούς, Rec., WH, mg.; on rendering with αὐτούς see Westc., in l), [[r:HEB.8.8|Heb 8:8.]]† (AS)

G3202.root: from a presumed derivative of [[w:G3201]] and μοῖρα (fate
G3202.strongs: akin to the base of); blaming fate, i.e. querulous (discontented)
senses: (μέμφομαι, + μοῖρα, fate, lot), complaining of one's fate, querulous: Ju 16 † (AS)
